schema:
CREATE TABLE Plans (plan_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bonus_points INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bonus_points >= 0));
CREATE TABLE Subscriptions (sub_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, plan_id INTEGER, base_points INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (base_points >= 0), FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES Plans (plan_id));
correct_query: SELECT SUM(s.base_points + COALESCE(p.bonus_points, 0)) AS total_points FROM Subscriptions AS s LEFT JOIN Plans AS p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Wraps nullable foreign key s.plan_id in COALESCE(s.plan_id, 0) in the LEFT JOIN ON condition, causing NULL foreign keys to spuriously match a parent row with plan_id = 0.
